articles.title: The Other Data Center Sprint — Federal Permitting, Not Just Tax Credits
articles.summary: OBBBA moves money forward. EO 14318 (July 2025) moves federal permitting and land forward for >100 MW AI campuses. Two levers, one race — and the questions county boards should ask.

articles.title: The Real Reason Data Centers Are Springing Up Everywhere (It's Not What You Think)
articles.summary: The surveillance-center rumor doesn't match the filings. The rush is compute, OBBBA and IRA tax clocks (equipment depreciation, wind/solar by 2026–2027), and grid interconnection queues.
